meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会进入“超工作模式”，强制先输出“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”，然后严格按规则执行任务：先调查技能和代码库，再创建目标、打开记事本、注册待办事项，最后通过测试驱动开发，确保每个成功标准都有证据。
howto.when: 当用户提示中包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式，帮我修复这个 bug。
say.note: Claude 会启动超工作模式，按规则修复 bug。
Claude 会进入超工作模式，按规则实现功能。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude enters 'ultrawork mode', first outputs 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then strictly follows rules: survey skills and codebase, create goal, open notepad, register todos, and drive test-first development with evidence for each criterion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix this bug.
say_en.note: Claude will start ultrawork mode and fix the bug per rules.
Claude will enter ultrawork mode and implement the feature per rules.
